correctness.rationale: Cycle threshold t=ceil(3ρ) takes values 1,2,3. For t1 any nonempty seeds spread through the connected graph. For t2 at least one cycle seed is necessary and sufficient together with at most one unsupported pair in each gap: spreading from gap ends proves sufficiency and two unsupported positions create an inert interval. For t3 every cycle/leaf pair must be seeded and leaf-only positions form an independent set. Gap weights Q_l=z^l+l z^(l−1), cycle independent sets, and counting maximum independent sets prove the three polynomials and exact minimizers. Independent synchronous simulation exhaustively checked all subsets for n=3..7.
